title: Reconstruction from a unit minor and vanishing bordered minors
statement: Let R be a commutative ring, n,p,d natural numbers, P an n-by-p matrix over R, and rows:Fin d↪Fin n and cols:Fin d↪Fin p embeddings. Suppose det(P.submatrix rows cols) is a unit and every (d+1)-minor obtained using row and column embeddings has determinant zero. Write B=P.submatrix rows cols, L=P.submatrix id cols, and H=P.submatrix rows id. Then P=L B⁻¹ H, where B⁻¹ is the nonsingular matrix inverse and all products are matrix products. No nontriviality or positivity assumptions are imposed.
lean_statement: ∀ {R : Type*} [CommRing R] (n p d : ℕ) (P : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin p) R) (rows : Fin d ↪ Fin n) (cols : Fin d ↪ Fin p) (_hunit : IsUnit (Matrix.det (P.submatrix rows cols))) (_hnext : ∀ (rows' : Fin (d + 1) ↪ Fin n) (cols' : Fin (d + 1) ↪ Fin p), Matrix.det (P.submatrix rows' cols') = 0), P = (P.submatrix id cols) * (P.submatrix rows cols)⁻¹ * (P.submatrix rows id)
